name: Fenugreek

schedule.notes: Succession every 2 to 3 weeks for fresh leaves. Doesn't transplant well.
Leaves (methi): 4 to 6 weeks. Seeds: when pods turn brown and dry, 90 to 100 days.

harvest.cues: Leaves at 6 to 8 in for the whole plant; or cut individual leaves. Seeds when pods are crisp and brown.
harvest.storageNotes: Fresh leaves: fridge 5 days. Dried leaves: a year in airtight jars. Seeds keep indefinitely.

varieties.name: Methi
varieties.notes: Standard dual-purpose. Indian markets sell both fresh leaves and seeds under this name.

notes: Fixes nitrogen — a great cover crop. Leaves taste like a cross between celery and maple syrup; seeds carry the distinctive curry-powder note. Bolts above 80 F.
